tie_reference: TIE (2026). Business Studies for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.
source_note: Verified Business Studies Form One schemes of work (Arusha Catholic Seminary) for Term I and Term II. 3 periods per week (one 80-min double and one 40-min single). Term I covers Introduction to Business Studies (Chapter 1), Entrepreneurship (Chapter 2) and Sole Proprietorship (Chapter 3); Term II covers comprehensive revision of Chapters 1-3 plus a practical business project. Weeks for mid-term assessments, revision and examinations carry no specific teaching activity.
